hero.title: Mechanical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: A **Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** is suitable for students who are interested in designing machines, developing industrial systems, working with vehicles and understanding the working of mechanical equipment. For the 2026–2027 academic year, the University of Mauritius offers a four-year full-time undergraduate program, Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Mechanical Engineering. Students planning to **Study Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius** can explore this undergraduate pathway and its related study options.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Mechanical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Mechanical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Mechanical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
